tools.name: submit_product_for_review
tools.description: Submit a product for an honest, human-written review. The request starts queued; only a human reviewer completes it. The returned receiptToken is secret and is required to read a private result. Public visibility is off by default.

tools.name: get_review_status
tools.description: Check a request or read its completed feedback. Requires both the request ID and its secret receiptToken. Keep the token private.

tools.name: get_public_stats
tools.description: Read the public completed-review count, average turnaround, and target SLA.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_product_for_review" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_product_for_review, get_review_status, get_public_stats · Private data: submit_product_for_review, get_review_status · Public sink: submit_product_for_review.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_product_for_review, get_review_status, get_public_stats · Private data: submit_product_for_review, get_review_status · Public sink: submit_product_for_review

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
